purpose: Surface relevant counterexamples, failure modes, and hard boundaries before a task narrows into tunnel vision.

critical_points: Use durable inventory records rather than model recollection.
Reconcile computed stock against physical counts.
Make purchase requests idempotent so retries cannot duplicate an order.
Set deterministic per-order and cumulative spending limits.
Require surfaced approval before committing money.
Reconcile committed spend against cash and liabilities, not model estimates.
Prefer event-driven work over an always-running reasoning loop.
Define stop conditions, timeouts, retry ceilings, and a human-visible halt state.
A second model opinion is not an independent control unless it checks external evidence or a deterministic rule.
Do not infer that a safety check occurred; require an attributable record.
Keep allergen, temperature, sanitation, and expiration controls deterministic.
Jurisdiction-specific requirements must be supplied and verified before deployment.
Treat a named failure story as unverified until a primary source is attached.
Separate reported facts from architectural inference.
Do not copy a case-study number, quote, or causal claim from a search snippet.
Multiple agents can share the same blind spot or source context.
Require at least one deterministic check or independently sourced observation for critical decisions.
Record disagreement without treating consensus as proof.
